name: paradigm-scanner
description: Paradigm Networks plugin for Cursor: automatically checks prompts and file changes for security risks — like destructive commands or unsafe code — before they're allowed through.

PARADIGM_NETWORKS_URL.title: Paradigm Networks base URL
PARADIGM_NETWORKS_URL.description: Your organization's Paradigm Networks URL, e.g. https://acme.paradigmnetworks.ai

PARADIGM_NETWORKS_FAILURE_MODE.title: If the scanner is unreachable during a file write
PARADIGM_NETWORKS_FAILURE_MODE.description: Block the write (recommended, default) or allow it through unscanned.

PARADIGM_NETWORKS_PROMPT_FAILURE_MODE.title: If the scanner is unreachable while submitting a prompt
PARADIGM_NETWORKS_PROMPT_FAILURE_MODE.description: Allow the prompt through unscanned (default — required so a not-yet-logged-in user is never blocked), or block it once your team is fully onboarded.
